name: CROPPED TWO-POCKET SHIRT
summary: Boxy cropped shirt; pointed collar, twin chest pockets, long set-in sleeves and button cuffs.
fabrics: Linen/cotton plain weave; 150 gsm; 140 cm usable width.
Unlined. Two chest patch pockets in shell; included in F01.
Soft woven fusible, 35 gsm; collar, stand, cuffs and placket.
trims: 11 mm 4-hole; 5 front, 4 cuff, 1 spare. Match each colorway.
Core-spun polyester, Tex 24; lockstitch and overlock.
6 mm lightweight woven tape at shoulder seams.
front: Collar and 2.5 cm stand: fuse one layer; 301 join at 1 cm SA. Grade/turn collar; enclose neck join in stand; edge stitch 2 mm.
Front placket 2.5 cm finished. Five front buttons and five holes including collar; body holes vertical, collar hole horizontal.
Patch pockets 11.5 x 12 cm (M). Top turn 0.5 + 1.5 cm; sides/base 1 cm. 301 edge stitch; reinforce top corners. Top 20 cm below HPS; inner edge 4 cm from CF. Grade per P09.
Shoulders: 301 at 1 cm SA, 10–12 SPI; insert 6 mm woven stay. 504 finish allowances together; press towards back.
Set-in sleeves: 301 armhole at 1 cm SA, then 504 finish together. Distribute crown ease smoothly; no visible gathers.
Cuffs 5 cm finished: fuse outer, attach at 1 cm SA, enclose inner edge. Two buttons and two holes per cuff, 2 cm apart.
Body hem: double turn 0.6 + 0.6 cm; 301 edge stitch 2 mm from fold. Keep front and back level; no side vents.
back: Sleeve underarm seams: 301 join at 1 cm SA, then 504 finish together. Press allowances towards back; match wrist plackets.
Back-wrist sleeve slit 10 cm: bind with a continuous self strip, enclose raw edges and secure the slit base before cuff attachment.
Side seams: 301 at 1 cm SA, then 504 finish allowances together. Press to back; align underarm joins and hem.
Internal main label: centered on back body, 1 cm below stand seam. Stitch end folds only; size pip below. Keep collar stand free.
Internal care label: insert in left side seam, 10 cm above finished hem. Secure insertion tab in allowance; soft printed face to inside.
care:
MACHINE WASH 30°C GENTLE
DO NOT BLEACH
DO NOT TUMBLE DRY
WARM IRON ON REVERSE
LINE DRY IN SHADE
labelplace: Inside center back neck, 1 cm below stand seam.
fold: Close front buttons. Fold sleeves inward; fold sides to 28 cm, then hem up once.
tagplace: Loop string under the inside back-neck brand label. Include 1 spare shirt button on the tag string.

name: HIGH-RISE STRIPE LEGGING
summary: High-rise ankle legging; wide contoured waistband, close fit and three red stripes along each outer leg.
fabrics: 4-way stretch interlock; 250 gsm; 150 cm usable width. Target at least 70% usable crosswise extension with good recovery.
Self-fabric inner waistband; included in F01 consumption.
No separate crotch insert. Both leg panels included in F01.
trims: 6 mm nylon/elastane knit tape; 6 x 86.6 cm cuts (M), incl. 6 mm waist SA + 2 cm hem turn. Knit selvedges; lengthwise stretch at least 50%.
Core-spun polyester Tex 24 needles; textured polyester loopers. White assembly / red stripe-application needle thread; match other colorways.
8 mm knit elastic; usable extension at least 70%. M: 65 cm cut incl. 1 cm lap = 64 cm loop; 0.68 m usage incl. waste.
front: Contoured waistband, 9 cm finished at CF/CB. Join outer/inner top edge with 514, 6 mm SA; turn. Quarter lower edges and attach to body using 514, 6 mm SA.
Top elastic: M cut 65 cm incl. 1 cm lap = 64 cm loop; zigzag lap. Secure elastic to inner band only with narrow zigzag, upper edge 1 mm below top seam line; keep top join clear.
CF rise: 514 four-thread overedge at 6 mm SA to the crotch intersection. Secure thread tails; retain seam extension.
Outseams: 514, 6 mm SA. Lay joined panels flat; center three 6 mm stretch tapes over each seam with 4 mm clear gaps (26 mm band).
Apply tapes before inseams: guided 406 bottom coverstitch, 3.2 mm gauge centered on each tape; no tape tension. Carry ends into waistband join and 2 cm hem turn.
Inseams: 514 at 6 mm SA; match knee/ankle notches. Join the continuous crotch/rise seam through the inseam intersection; stagger allowances and secure tails.
Ankle hem: turn 2 cm; 406 two-needle bottom coverstitch, 6.4 mm gauge. Trial shell/tape assembly for full extension and recovery without stitch break.
back: CB rise: 514 four-thread overedge at 6 mm SA, continuous with CF rise through the crotch intersection. Match inseam joins; do not stretch the seat curve.
Waistband CB join: 514 at 6 mm SA. Place elastic lap 2 cm away from CB seam to reduce stacked bulk; maintain 9 cm finished band height.
Internal brand/size: soft stretch transfers at center back waistband; size 5 mm below brand. Trial heat/pressure on shell before application. No exterior logo.
Internal care label: insert soft satin tab in left waistband seam. Enclose cut edge; keep label clear of elastic lap and CB join.
pom: HALF WAIST, RELAXED AT TOP EDGE
HALF HIP, 18 CM BELOW WAIST TOP
FRONT RISE, FOLLOW CF SEAM INC. BAND
BACK RISE, FOLLOW CB SEAM INC. BAND
care:
MACHINE WASH 30°C GENTLE
DO NOT BLEACH
DO NOT TUMBLE DRY
DO NOT IRON
LINE DRY; NO SOFTENER
labelplace: Soft heat transfer inside center back waistband.
fold: Lay legs together, fold at crotch line; fold into thirds. Keep side stripes flat.
tagplace: Loop string through the care-label insertion tab inside left waistband; no exterior logo tag.

name: GATHERED BUST SLIP MAXI DRESS
summary: Ankle-length satin slip dress with gathered V-neck bust, pointed empire seam, adjustable straps and low V back.
fabrics: Satin 140 gsm; 145 cm usable width. True-bias skirt; estimated usage includes self straps; confirm marker.
Soft polyester lining, 65 gsm; bust and upper body only.
6 mm lightweight fusible stay tape at zip and neckline edges.
trims: No. 3 concealed nylon zip, 30 cm at center back; closed end.
6 mm rings and sliders, low-nickel finish; straps 5 mm.
Fine core-spun polyester, Tex 18; fine sharp needle 65/9.
front: V neckline: stay to seam-line length; 301 join shell and lining at 1 cm SA. Grade/clip as needed; understitch on lining 1 mm from seam where accessible.
Bust gathers: two temporary gathering rows within 1 cm SA; draw up between notches on each lower bust panel. Distribute evenly, then 301 join to skirt.
CF empire point: staystitch in SA; 301 pivot accurately at apex. Clip concave allowance close to stitching without cutting it; grade and press allowances down.
Spaghetti straps: self-fabric, 5 mm finished. Turn without twisting; reinforce front attachment inside neckline SA before bagging lining.
Partial bust/upper-body lining: attach at neck and zipper tapes. Finish free lower edge 1 cm below empire level; tack at side allowances only, clear of bias skirt.
Skirt: one front and two back panels on true 45° bias. Mark grain on each pattern piece; cut single ply and handle flat without stretching. Confirm balanced hang on sample.
Side seams: 301 at 1 cm SA; narrow 504 finish together and press to back. Fine needle/low tension; protect satin face from press shine.
Hang shell 24 hours, then level hem. Turn 0.6 + 0.6 cm and 301 edge stitch 2 mm from fold without roping; retain gentle A-line flare.
back: Low V back: stabilize neckline to seam-line length with lightweight stay. Bag with lining, grade/turn and understitch where accessible; no separate facing.
Strap adjusters: one 6 mm ring and slider each side for 5 mm strap. Fold rear anchor around ring; bury and reinforce ends in neckline SA. Check both adjusters slide.
CB concealed zip: 30 cm opening, 1.5 cm SA. Stabilize shell allowances before insertion; 301 sew tapes with concealed-zip foot. Top stops 0.5 cm below neck; lining clear of coil.
CB seam below zip: 301 at 1.5 cm SA up to zip base without a step. 504 finish edges separately and press open; secure lower zip tapes to allowances only.
Back waist darts: 301 from wide end to point, taper to zero and tie off. Press towards CB on a shaped support; do not flatten dart tips.
Internal brand/size label: on back lining, 2 cm below neck edge; nearest label edge 2 cm to wearer left of zip. Stitch lining only; keep coil free.
Internal care label: left lining side seam, 10 cm below underarm. Secure insertion tab to lining allowance; no stitches through shell.
pom: BODY LENGTH, FRONT BODICE APEX TO HEM
FINISHED STRAP PATH, FRONT JOIN TO BACK RING
FRONT V DROP FROM BODICE APEX LEVEL
BACK V DROP FROM FRONT APEX LEVEL
CF EMPIRE DROP FROM BODICE APEX LEVEL
care:
HAND WASH COLD
DO NOT BLEACH
DO NOT TUMBLE DRY
COOL IRON ON REVERSE
LINE DRY IN SHADE
labelplace: Back lining only: 2 cm below edge; nearest label edge 2 cm left of zip.
fold: Close zip. Place tissue at bust; fold sides inward, then skirt in three soft folds.
tagplace: Loop string under the back-lining brand label; keep clear of zip coil and satin face.

name: FLAT-FRONT TAPERED TROUSER
summary: Slim tapered ankle trouser with flat front, fixed waistband, zip fly and slant side pockets.
fabrics: Cotton stretch twill; 220 gsm; 145 cm width. Includes fly facing/shield, pocket facings, welts and loops.
Cotton plain weave, 95 gsm; front and back pocket bags.
Woven fusible 45 gsm: waistband, fly/welt areas and 6 mm pocket-opening stays.
trims: No. 3 nylon coil fly zipper, 15 cm; locking slider.
17 mm 4-hole waist button; 1 fitted and 1 spare.
Core-spun polyester, Tex 30; 301 assembly and 504 overlock.
front: Waistband 4 cm finished: fuse outer layer; 301 attach at 1 cm SA. Turn ends, grade corners and enclose body join with clean inner edge.
Fly: 15 cm locking coil zip, 3 cm fly facing and separate self shield. Attach tapes to extension/facing; shield behind zip. 301 J-stitch 3 cm from CF; bartack base clear of coil.
Closure: one 17 mm waist button and horizontal buttonhole. Check overlap/CF alignment with fly closed. Attach one spare button to hangtag string.
Slant pockets 16 cm: stay opening with 6 mm F03 strip; self facings on F02 bags. 301 join, turn/understitch and edge stitch; close bags with 301 + 504. Bartack opening ends.
Five belt loops: 1 cm finished width, 5 cm clear length. Enclose raw edges; secure each end. CB loop centered; side loops align with pocket mouths.
Outseams: 301 at 1 cm SA; 504 finish allowances together and press towards back. Match hip/knee notches without stretching pocket opening.
Inseams: 301 at 1 cm SA; 504 finish together, press towards back. Match crotch/knee notches and avoid leg rotation.
Hem: 504 finish raw edge, turn 2.5 cm and blind hem with minimal face pickup. Keep opening level; no turn-up cuff. Press without flattening twill texture.
back: Back darts: 10 cm from lower waistband seam to dart point at welt-opening level. Sew 301 towards point and tie off; press towards CB before making welts.
Single-welt pockets: fuse F03 opening area. Finished opening 13 x 1 cm. 301 welt/bag seams, slash to corners, turn and secure corner triangles without cutting stitches.
F02 back bags: self facing above opening, finished depth 16 cm below welt; 301 + 504 close edges and catch bag tops at waistband. Welt 10 cm below band; inner end 5 cm from CB.
Seat seam: 301 at 1.5 cm SA with second reinforcing row on crotch curve. 504 edges separately and press open. Match true crotch intersection without bulky folded allowances.
Internal brand label: center back waistband, 1 cm below top edge. 301 stitch end folds to inner waistband only; insert size pip below.
Internal care label: secure in left front pocket-bag seam, printed face inside bag. Keep clear of pocket opening; no label stitching through trouser face.
pom: HALF HIP, 20 CM BELOW WAIST TOP
INSEAM, FOLLOW SEAM FROM CROTCH TO HEM
FRONT RISE, FOLLOW CF SEAM INCLUDING BAND
BACK RISE, FOLLOW CB SEAM INCLUDING BAND
care:
MACHINE WASH 30°C GENTLE
DO NOT BLEACH
DO NOT TUMBLE DRY
WARM IRON ON REVERSE
LINE DRY IN SHADE
labelplace: Inside center back waistband, 1 cm below top.
fold: Close fly. Align inseams; fold legs together, then in thirds without hard creases.
tagplace: Loop string under inside back-waist brand label. Include 1 spare waist button on the tag string.

name: CLEAN-FRONT PULLOVER HOODIE
summary: Relaxed drop-shoulder pullover hoodie; double-layer hood, clean front, rib cuffs and rib hem. No pockets or drawcord.
fabrics: Brushed-back fleece; 340 gsm; 170 cm usable width. Includes four hood panels; nap one way. Wash shrinkage target max 3%; confirm marker.
Self-fabric hood lining; included in F01 consumption.
2 x 2 cotton/elastane rib; 95/5; 380 gsm; 100 cm tubular.
trims: 10 mm cotton herringbone tape; back neck seam covering.
Core-spun needle thread Tex 30; textured polyester loopers.
6 mm clear elastic shoulder stay; enclose during overlock.
front: Self-lined hood: two outer and two inner pieces. After joining CB seams and bagging opening, baste 2 cm CF overlap in SA. 514 attach both layers to body neck at 6 mm SA.
Hood opening: outer/inner right sides together, 514 at 6 mm SA, turn and press. Secondary 406 bottom coverstitch, 3.2 mm gauge, 6 mm from edge.
Dropped shoulders: 514 four-thread overedge at 6 mm SA; enclose 6 mm clear elastic stay without stretching it. Press allowances towards sleeves.
Set sleeves flat to dropped armholes: 514, 6 mm SA. Then close sleeve underarm and body side in one run, matching underarm junctions; no side split.
Rib cuffs 6.5 cm finished; sample M relaxed closed circumference 19 cm. Close loop at underarm; quarter and join using 514, 6 mm SA, stretching rib only. Grade per P09.
Hem rib 7 cm finished; M relaxed circumference 98 cm. Close loop at left side; quarter to body and attach using 514 at 6 mm SA with even distribution.
Cuff/hem finishing: after 514 attachment, lay allowances towards body and add 406 bottom coverstitch, 6.4 mm gauge, 8–10 SPI. This is secondary topstitching; retain seam extension.
back: Hood CB: join outer and inner center seams separately with 514 at 6 mm SA. Nest allowances in opposite directions before joining the opening; self lining remains free of body back.
Back neck covering: 10 mm cotton herringbone tape, shoulder to shoulder; turn ends and 301 stitch both edges over neck SA. Leave front neck untaped for pull-on extension.
Internal brand label: on back neck tape, hood lifted. 301 tack upper 6 mm of each end fold to tape only. Sew folded size pip to lower brand-label edge before attaching label; keep body free.
Internal care label: insert in left side seam, 10 cm above rib join. Secure tab within allowance, soft face inside; keep label clear when trimming overlock.
pom: HOOD HEIGHT, NECK SEAM TO CROWN
care:
MACHINE WASH 30°C GENTLE
WASH INSIDE OUT
DO NOT BLEACH
DO NOT TUMBLE DRY
COOL IRON; LINE DRY
labelplace: Inside center back neck tape; size pip below.
fold: Fold hood flat to back. Fold sleeves and body sides inward, then hem up once.
tagplace: Loop string under the inside back-neck label; do not attach to rib hem or pierce fleece.
